display_long_description:
Become the ultimate darts player in **Darts VR2: Bullseye**.

Combining realistic physics with competitive and casual gameplay, **Darts VR2: Bullseye** is the one-stop shop for darts fans worldwide. From mastering the hallowed 9-darter in 501 to fighting the Zombie menace with a friend, enjoy a game of darts at whatever your skill level. 

And when you think you’ve got what it takes to be a champion, you can join the seasonal League mode…

[media]

# Real Darts
Built to provide a hyper-realistic darts experience, every throw is a test of your patience and skill. There’s no aim-assist here!  

[media]

# Multi-Modes!
Achieve success in a classic match of 501, hold back the Zombie hordes with headshots & explosive darts, or rack up a new high score on Killstreak! 

[media]

# Unlock Rewards
Don’t simply play darts, gain XP with every throw and level up to unlock new darts, avatars and more!

[media]

# Challenge Your Friends
No game of darts is quite the same without a friend to play against. Featuring full cross-platform play, challenge opponents in 501, or fight side-by-side in Zombies.

Step up to the Oche and experience the excitement of **Darts VR2: Bullseye**.
